qs.q: A clinician plans the initial diagnostic evaluation for a 2-year-old child with unexplained global developmental delay. Thyroid function testing is routinely included in this work-up primarily for which reason?
o: It identifies a treatable metabolic condition
qs.e: Thyroid function tests are performed because congenital hypothyroidism is a treatable metabolic cause of developmental delay. It is distinct from chromosomal disorders like fragile X syndrome which cannot be reversed by hormone replacement.

qs.q: Global developmental delay is defined as a delay in:
o: Two or more areas before age five
qs.e: It requires delay in two or more domains before age 5. The other options do not meet the definition.

qs.q: A 2-year-old child presents with global developmental delay and delayed attainment of milestones. Which of the following clinical features warrants proceeding directly to cerebral magnetic resonance imaging?
qs.e: Focal neurological signs, seizures, or regression are clear indications for neuroimaging in developmental delay. Isolated speech delay or a family history of learning difficulties rarely requires immediate brain imaging.
